fields.name: content_heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The first, grey line of the heading. Warning: text longer than 14 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: content_headingHighlight
fields.label: Heading: dark line
fields.description: The second, dark line of the heading. Warning: text longer than 14 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: search_placeholder
fields.label: Search box placeholder
fields.description: Warning: text longer than 35 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: search_help
fields.label: Search box description
fields.description: The text under the search box (three lines at most). Warning: text longer than 130 characters is cut short with “…”.
fields.value: Search by role, team, or skill. New roles open up as the team grows, so check back soon for what’s new.

fields.name: search_filtersLabel
fields.label: Filters label
fields.description: The label above the filter dropdowns (the Filter items of this block). Warning: text longer than 20 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: search_emptyMessage
fields.label: No results message
fields.description: Shown when no role matches the search and filters (two lines at most). Warning: text longer than 80 characters is cut short with “…”.
fields.value: No roles found matching your criteria.

fields.name: search_clearAll
fields.label: Clear all button
fields.description: Beside the filters label, once a filter option is ticked. Warning: text longer than 15 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: search_backToTop
fields.label: Back to top button
fields.description: Under the role list, once it is scrolled down. Warning: text longer than 25 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: roleName
fields.label: Job title
fields.description: Warning: a title longer than 65 characters is cut short with “…” (two lines at most). Only the first 15 Job Roles are shown on the page.

fields.name: meta_department
fields.label: Department
fields.description: Warning: text longer than 35 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: meta_location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: As shown, e.g. Pune, India. The Locations filter matches its options against this. Warning: text longer than 20 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: meta_tags
fields.label: Other filter values
fields.description: Not shown: words for the other filters (e.g. Experience), separated by commas, e.g. 3-5 years, Full-time. At most 100 characters.

fields.name: button
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: The application page or form for this role.

fields.name: buttonText
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: Warning: at most 15 characters, so the button keeps its size.

fields.name: categoryName
fields.label: Dropdown name
fields.description: Shown on the dropdown until options are ticked, e.g. Locations. Warning: text longer than 25 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: filterField
fields.label: Matches the role's
fields.description: Which part of each Job Role the chosen option is looked for in.

fields.name: filterOptions
fields.label: Options
fields.description: The checkboxes of this dropdown: click Add for each one, e.g. Pune, India. Warning: an option longer than 35 characters is cut short with “…”.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Alt text
fields.description: Describes the image for screen readers. At most 125 characters.
